snippet.title: Stage Tour - Official Play Your Way Trailer
snippet.description:
*👉️ Pre-order physical hardware and game bundles at* https://StageTour.com

*⭐️ Digital pre-orders are now live* on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Epic Games Store. 

*Pre-order now and save 10%.*
*PlayStation Store discount available to PlayStation Plus members only. 

*Pre-order on PlayStation 5:*
https://stgame.io/ps5

*Pre-order on Xbox Series X|S:*
https://stgame.io/xbox

*Pre-order on PC (Steam):*
https://stgame.io/steam

*Pre-order on PC (Epic Games Store):*
https://stgame.io/epic

Build your band, hit the stage, and play your way! 🤘

• No instrument controller required 
• Play with a gamepad or gaming keyboard
• Select legacy instruments supported
• New official Stage Tour hardware
• 90+ officially licensed songs 
• 180+ authentic in-game @gibsonguitar guitars
• 50+ bandmates
• Up to four players locally, online, or cross-platform
• New ways to play and more! 

*Stage Tour launches December 10, 2026. 📅*

*PLAY YOUR WAY*
Supports Lead Guitar, Groove Guitar/Bass, Drums, Vocals, Gaming Keyboard, and gamepad for 4-Lane and 5-Lane Arcade Mode. Pick up your instrument of choice and choose from Easy, Medium, Hard, or Expert difficulties. Or, Expert Plus on Drums.

*90+ OFFICIALLY LICENSED SONGS*
Rock out to a launch setlist spanning six decades of music, featuring Metallica, The Rolling Stones, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Olivia Rodrigo, blink-182, Paramore, Slipknot, Muse and more!

*180+ COLLECTIBLE GUITARS*
Discover, unlock and collect more than 180 authentic in-game Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars throughout Stage Tour

*GO ON TOUR*
Take on the all-new roguelite Tour Mode, where every run brings new choices, challenges and opportunities for your band, creating an endlessly replayable experience.

*PLAY TOGETHER*
Take the stage solo or with a band in cooperative multiplayer with local or online play, including cross-platform play. Mix and match instruments in any combination and play together your way.

*BUILD YOUR BAND*
Choose from 50+ unique bandmates and build a lineup that reflects your style. Mix, match and make your band your own.

*MORE WAYS TO PLAY*
Jump into Quickplay, sharpen your skills in Practice and Judgements, or keep things casual with Karaoke.
